subject: LaTeX hyperref index in Stan manual?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: LaTeX hyperref index in Stan manual?
parts:
Does anyone know how to fix our LaTeX so that the
index entries are hyperlinked back to the pages on
which they occur?

The dev team's stumped; I've personally spent an
embarassing amount of time trying different alternatives
to no avail.

The style file's in

$stan/src/docs/stan-reference/stan-manuals.sty

and there's an auxiliary style file in the same
directory in file:

stan-reference.ist

There seem to be all kinds of bad interactions with hyperref
and with makeidx. And I've made it even more conufsing by
going through a LaTeX macro to auto-generate the index with
headings, subheadings, and styles.

I'd be happy to change our indexing format or the package
on which it depends if that's what it takes.

I'd be happy to hear hints as well as complete solutions,
but please don't just point me in the general direction of
TUG or the hyperref doc, both of which I've studied in depth.

Thanks!

- Bob

P.S. I'm also happy to send anyone who fixes this problem
a Stan t-shirt (S, L, XL, or 2XL left). And I'll thank you
in the manual acknowledgments, but that's just common
courtesy.

P.P.S. I need to figure out how to set up a shop so people can
buy the T-shirts. Or hats. Or mugs. Suggestions
appreciated. We ordered from CustomInk, who are great,
but they don't set up storefronts like Cafe Press, etc.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] LaTeX hyperref index in Stan manual?
parts:
I got it working; patch sent via github: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/pull/24

I'm not sure why my patch works and setting hyperindex=true for hyperref does not, but the hyperref manual has lots of warnings about the index links being fragile. This question http://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/23785/italic-index-entries-have-no-link-in-pdf pointed me in the right direction.
